text:
maria: Heads-up: we got a burn-rate alert on api-serving.slo overnight — backend burn ~0.45 over 1h. Anyone know if that's expected? Logs show a spike of 5xx from eu region around 02:10.

sre-bot: Alert fired: slo-burn-rate api-serving.slo > 0.4 (1h) at 1823456789. Incident auto-created if escalation rules met.

jonathan: Oncall checked earlier — looks like a traffic surge from retriers hitting /v1/generate. Traces show a cluster of gateway 504s and backend timeouts. Short trace: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/0xabc123

alex: Quick q: is the dashboard using a 1h window for critical, or are we evaluating 6h? I thought production criticals were 6h.

kai: Config is 1h critical / 6h warning for api-serving. See grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/serving/slo-overview?var-slo=api-serving

maria: Ok. If it's noise from retries we should filter, otherwise we might need to relax thresholds. Proposal: keep 1h critical but bump from 0.4 -> 0.5 temporarily, keep 6h warn at 0.3. Thoughts?

jonathan: I'd rather not raise critical. We can reduce false positives by excluding internal retries/health probes from the error numerator. Example tweak for Prometheus rule: 

```
# prometheus alert expression (example)
sum(rate(slo_error_total{job="api", region!~"internal|ops", replay!~"true|retry"}[1h]))
/
sum(rate(slo_total{job="api", region!~"internal|ops"}[1h])) > 0.5
```

This excludes known replay/retry labels and internal probes that were inflating the error rate.

alex: Nice. Where does that rule live? infra/monitoring/prometheus/rules/slo.rules.yaml?

kai: Yes — that repo. Open a PR against infra-monitoring, include the query change and a short note about the retrier noise. Tag @kai and @oncall. Also add a Grafana annotation for the deploy at 02:05 so we can correlate.

maria: I'll open the PR now with the filtered query and keep the 0.4 threshold for critical. I'll also add a dashboard panel link and annotate the 02:05 deploy. Will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Note: created incident ticket incident-1823456790 for follow-up.

jonathan: Thanks — once PR is merged we'll monitor burn rate for 24h and re-evaluate thresholds.

maria: Quick checklist: PR -> merge -> monitor 24h -> follow-up in daily SLO sync if still noisy.

alex: Ack, I'll review the PR when you post it.
